imd._note: IMD's latest extended-range outlook, refreshed by the Nykas Daily Refresh when IMD issues a new one (usually Thursdays). categories: above / near / below for an IMD sub-division only when IMD states it; otherwise left out.
imd.title: IMD extended range forecast (weekly press release), 5 November 2026: current weather status and extended range forecast for the next two weeks (5 to 18 November 2026)
imd.summary: For 5–11 November IMD expects isolated to scattered rain over Tamil Nadu, Rayalaseema and Coastal Andhra Pradesh, becoming fairly widespread to widespread over Tamil Nadu on 7–8 November, with below-normal rainfall over some parts of south Peninsular India. For 12–18 November it expects above-normal rainfall over south Peninsular India in the first half of the week and near-normal in the second half, with isolated heavy rain over Tamil Nadu and Kerala on some days.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.text: Isolated to scattered rainfall likely over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal on 5–6 and 9–11 November, becoming fairly widespread to widespread on 7–8 November; isolated to scattered rainfall over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam, Rayalaseema, Coastal Karnataka, Kerala & Mahe and Lakshadweep, with isolated heavy rain over Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and Tamil Nadu. Below-normal rainfall is likely over some parts of south Peninsular India.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Isolated to scattered rainfall likely during 5–11 November; IMD gives no separate category for Rayalaseema, saying only that below-normal rainfall is likely over some parts of south Peninsular India.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated to scattered rainfall on 5–6 and 9–11 November and fairly widespread to widespread rainfall on 7–8 November, with isolated heavy rain likely; below-normal rainfall is likely over some parts of south Peninsular India.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.text: Above-normal rainfall activity is likely over South Peninsular India in the first half of the week and near-normal rainfall activity in the second half, with isolated heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu and Kerala on some days.

regional_text.Rayalaseema: Not named separately; IMD expects above-normal rainfall over South Peninsular India in the first half of the week and near-normal in the second half.
regional_text.Tamil Nadu: Isolated heavy rainfall likely on some days; above-normal rainfall over South Peninsular India in the first half of the week and near-normal in the second half.

season.text: IMD's monthly outlook for November 2026: rainfall over South Peninsular India (Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam, Rayalaseema, Kerala & Mahe and South Interior Karnataka taken together) is most likely to be below normal (less than 77% of the long-period average of about 118.7 mm).
